provenance: nlqdb's own docs/ corpus, extracted by the open-source docs→memory skill and synced one-way into a real agent_memory_v1 Postgres DB. Read through the published @nlqdb/mcp server — no privileged path.

goldenQueries.sql:
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM facts
 GROUP BY kind
 ORDER BY n DESC;

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM entities
 GROUP BY type
 ORDER BY n DESC;

knownGap: 1 of 12 asks returned a confident wrong answer: asked for “open questions”, the planner guessed kind='question' and got 0 — the corpus stores 'open_question', true count 11. A known schema-value-linking gap (E-09). We publish the miss, not just the wins.
